title: Grammar Practice
description:
A-Rewrite each pair of sentences using nominalization (turn the main verb into a noun). Don’t forget
to adjust the second clause to fit the noun phrase.
1-People exercise regularly. They improve their mental health.

___________________________________________________________________________
5-People use energy-efficient appliances. They lower carbon emissions.
___________________________________________________________________________
6-Students participate in mindfulness exercises. They reduce their stress levels.
__________________________________________________________________________
7-People use energy-efficient appliances. They lower carbon emissions.
___________________________________________________________________________
8-Doctors monitor patients regularly. They detect health problems early.
___________________________________________________________________________
9-Researchers collect data from surveys. They analyze it for trends.
___________________________________________________________________________
10-Engineers design sustainable buildings. They reduce energy consumption.
___________________________________________________________________________

___________________________________________________________________________

___________________________________________________________________________

15-Environmentalists promote recycling campaigns. They raise public awareness.

16-The errors in the sentence were removed, which made it look much better.
___________________________________________________________________________
17-Wealth is distributed around the world very unfairly.
___________________________________________________________________________

___________________________________________________________________________
19-The data was analysed and it showed that uptake of the drug had increased.
___________________________________________________________________________
B- Rewrite each of the following conditional sentences using inversion. Don’t forget to adjust the
verb tense after inversion.
 (Type 1 – Real Present/Future (use should)
 Type 2 – Unreal Present/Future (use were)
 Type 3 – Unreal Past (use had)
Example:
If you should need assistance, call the lab supervisor: Should you need assistance, call the lab supervisor.
1. If scientists were able to clone human organs safely, organ shortages would no longer exist.
